skills.name: Memento Mori
skills.desc:
Wind type slash attack on a single enemy (XL)
* Consumes all Geist stacks
** Geist stacked: 0 > 1 > 2 > 3 > 4
*** Multiplier: 200% > 400% > 600% > 800% > 1000%
*** Critical rate of skill: +30% > +40% > +60% > +80% > +100%
* When in ANY Stance: Increase critical damage +30%

skills.name: Ilulu turn end buff
skills.desc:
When in Dazzling Slash Stance: Increases sword, axe, katana damage +15% \ +30% \ +45% \ +60%
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Slash moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
